# Create Effect

Source: [wiki article 4342](../archive/4342.md); edited 2024-11-26.

Exact pinned API: [Create Effect](../../api/actions/create-effect.md).

<a id="wiki-4342-n1"></a>

- Effects persist until destroyed and expose Last Created Entity; new effects stop appearing at capacity.

<a id="wiki-4342-n2"></a>

- Archive gives 128 active Create Effect effects or 256 with extension.

<a id="wiki-4342-n3"></a>

- Player-valued positions follow players; team colors depend on viewer hostility and do not affect sounds; selected inputs reevaluate.
